yaml:
# W3-6 fixture: a job NO REAL AGENT CAN CLAIM.
#
# W3-6 needs an artifact PUT against a run that is already terminal, and no
# ordinary run can supply one: DELETE /api/v1/runs/{id} refuses a non-terminal
# run with 409 (internal/controller/api_runs.go:427-432), while a run driven by
# a real agent is Running for the whole of its uploadArtifact step. So the
# scenario drives the upload itself, from a curl-driven "synthetic agent" that
# enrolls, claims, finishes and then uploads — every step a documented
# production HTTP route.
#
# The selector is the whole point. `kind:w36probe` matches neither agent1 nor
# agent2 (both `kind:linux`), so a run of this job sits Queued until the
# synthetic identity claims it, and the two real agents are never involved in
# the measurement. The steps below never execute — the run is terminalised
# through POST /api/v1/agents/{id}/runs/{runId}/finish — so their content is
# deliberately trivial; they exist only because a Job needs at least one step.
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w36-probe
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:w36probe
  steps:
    - name: never_runs
      run: echo "w36-probe placeholder — this step is never executed"
